{{Quote|You talk brave for one who is about to journey down the throat of my favorite kell dragon.|Jabba the Hutt to Kyle Katarn before the latter's attempted execution|<ref name="Dark" />}}
The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] owned a pet '''kell dragon''' that he referred to as his favorite [[Kell dragon/Legends|kell dragon]]. Jabba's favorite was one of several kell dragons that lived on his [[Minstrel-class space yacht/Legends|''Minstrel''-class space yacht]] [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Jabba's [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] captured the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. While its [[Jan Ors|pilot]] was imprisoned, the ship's passenger, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]], was taken to be fed to Jabba's favorite kell dragon. However, Katarn [[Death/Legends|killed]] the beast with his [[Unarmed combat/Legends|bare hands]], and escaped the ''Star Jewel'' soon after.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm normally an optimistic guy, but how do you fight a Kell dragon with your bare hands?|Kyle Katarn questions his ability to fight the kell dragon|<ref name="Dark Forces Official Player's Guide">''[[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide]]''</ref>}}
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] had obtained a large, [[Color/Legends|green-skinned]] [[Kell dragon/Legends|kell dragon]]. Jabba came to regard the kell dragon as his favorite kell dragon out of the others that he owned. At some point, the kell dragon took residence on Jabba's [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] [[Minstrel-class space yacht/Legends|''Minstrel''-class space yacht]] [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']]. It lived in a large, spacious room that had two large doors on either side of it. One door led into a large execution pit.<ref name="Dark" />

During this time, Jabba was conducting business with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], supplying [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to aid [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]] in the creation of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] called [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]]. Mohc faced persistent opponents, however, whom Jabba did not know. As it were, Mohc's enemies were the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jan Ors]], the former being someone that Jabba was at least aware of. Katarn eventually [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Dark Trooper campaign)|raided]] an Imperial facility on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] which resulted in the theft of a [[nava card]] that contained the routes that Jabba's smugglers used. After Ors retrieved Katarn, their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' was captured by the ''Star Jewel''. Ors was imprisoned, the nava card stocked in a guarded room, and Katarn was brought before the kell dragon's pit.<ref name="Dark" />

Jabba, who was not aboard the ''Star Jewel'' at the time, conversed with Katarn briefly over a [[Holoprojector/Legends|Holoprojector]] seeing Katarn for the first time. Katarn threatened Jabba, to which the Hutt merely commented that the [[Human/Legends|human]] talked brave for someone who was about to be consumed. Jabba's only regret was that he would not be present to see his kell dragon in action. Katarn was thrown into the pit, and the door to the dragon's room opened, releasing the kell dragon. Against the odds, Katarn beat the kell dragon and [[Death/Legends|killed]] it with his [[Unarmed combat/Legends|bare hands]]. A door opened revealing more kell dragons and an exit, and Katarn fought his way through the ship, rescuing Jan and retrieving his gear and the nava card in the process, and the Rebels escaped the ''Star Jewel''.<ref name="Dark" />

==Personality and traits==
Jabba's favorite kell dragon was a large, green-skinned kell dragon with blue spines and white eyes with black irises. The kell dragon tended to leap at its prey.<ref name="Dark" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jabba's favorite kell dragon first appeared in the [[1995]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'', where it appeared at the start of the tenth level. Players could only fight the beast with their bare hands, and killing it was mandatory in order to continue the game. Depending on the game's difficulty level, the number of kell dragons that the player must initially face can change from one kell dragon to three kell dragons. However, more kell dragons are revealed only after the death of Jabba's favorite.
